description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Precision Graded Tephra Collector: Offers an accuracy class of 0.53%, ensuring reliable and precise measurement of tephra particles in various environments.
  • Fast Sampling Rate: Operates at a sampling rate of 1066.6 Hz, enabling rapid and continuous data collection for detailed analysis.
  • Wide Operating Temperature: Designed to function efficiently at temperatures up to 50°C, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor fieldwork.
  • Handheld and Portable Design: Easily mountable and lightweight, this tephra collector is ideal for on-the-go sampling and field studies.
  • Extended Calibration Interval: Requires calibration only once every 8 months, reducing maintenance needs and downtime.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Accurate Volcanic Ash Measurement: Delivers dependable results for researchers and professionals needing precise tephra or volcanic ash data.
  • Efficient Data Collection: High-frequency sampling supports real-time monitoring and rapid response scenarios.
  • User-Friendly Operation: Handheld design ensures ease of use in various field conditions, improving workflow and productivity.
  • Cost-Effective Maintenance: Long calibration intervals minimize service interruptions and lower total ownership costs.
  • Adaptable to Harsh Conditions: Withstands elevated temperatures, making it suitable for use near active volcanic sites or other demanding environments.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Field Research in Volcanology: Ideal for scientists and researchers collecting and analyzing volcanic ash or tephra deposits on-site.
  • Environmental Monitoring: Supports air quality assessment and particulate monitoring in regions affected by volcanic activity.
  • Educational and Laboratory Use: Suitable for teaching institutions and labs requiring accurate, real-time sampling of airborne particulates.
  • Disaster Response and Safety: Enables rapid deployment for monitoring ash fall during volcanic eruptions, helping inform public safety decisions.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is this device durable for field use?
    Yes, it is designed for robust operation in various environments, including high-temperature settings up to 50°C.
  • How often does it need calibration?
    Calibration is required only every 8 months, ensuring consistent accuracy with minimal maintenance.
  • Is it easy to transport and use?
    The handheld, portable design makes it convenient for field researchers and professionals needing mobility.
  • What is the pricing structure?
    Pricing is customized and provided after acceptance, allowing for flexibility based on specific project needs.

This graded tephra collector is engineered for accuracy, efficiency, and ease of use, making it a valuable tool for professionals and researchers involved in particulate or volcanic ash measurement.
